title: HTML entity unescape output remains encoded
reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "'Your string unescaped' shows © 2024 Café €5."

verdict.title: HTML entity unescape output remains encoded
verdict.oneLiner: The HTML entity unescape tool left the encoded entities in the output instead of converting them to ©, é, and €.
verdict.rootCause: The unescape result did not change the supplied HTML entities into their readable characters.
verdict.suggestion: Fix the unescape conversion so named entities such as ©, é, and € are decoded before the result is displayed.

rejectedBecause: By design: IT Tools describes this tool as escaping and unescaping only < > & " and ', so named entities like © are out of its scope. The attack expected more than the tool promises.
